content: When CallTrustedFunction is called and the caller of Call- TrustedFunction is supervised with timing protection, the Operating System shall delay any timing protection errors until the CallTrustedFunction returns to a OsApplication with OsTrustedApplicationDelayTimingViolationCall == FALSE .
